description:
kami tim mars & moon storytellers dari jakarta. suka bercerita dan tertarik dengan cerita tentang peralatan nasa yang ditinggalkan di bulan dan mars.

untuk challenge ini, kami membuat cerita berjudul "kenangan di antara bintang" tentang opportunity (oppy), rover yang sudah berhenti tapi tidak pernah dilupakan. kami ingin menceritakan kisahnya dengan cara yang hangat dan mudah dipahami.
summary:
KAMI DI SINI is an interactive storytelling website told from the perspective of NASA equipment left behind on the Moon and Mars.

Instead of a textbook, we let the objects speak for themselves: the Apollo 15 Hammer & Feather, the Fallen Astronaut, Ginny, and Oppy the Opportunity Rover. They were abandoned, but not forgotten. They are still there, still telling their story, still waiting for us to come home.

Made for school-age space enthusiasts, visitors scroll through a full-screen, emotional story that mixes real NASA history with a poetic, human voice - to make people feel connected to the hardware and the science it made possible.

Live Demo: https://kami-di-sini.oneapp.dev

Sources / Attributions:
- Hammer & Feather Apollo 15: NASA Image Library S71-43788
- Fallen Astronaut: NASA Image Library AS15-88-11894
- Ginny: NASA Image Library PIA24474
- Oppy: NASA Image Library PIA04413
All images from NASA Image Library - images.nasa.gov
details:
KAMI DI SINI is a single-page interactive storytelling website. Visitors scroll full-screen through 4 chapters, each told in first-person by a different piece of NASA equipment left on the Moon and Mars.

We built it with HTML, CSS, and JavaScript, with a starfield animation and full-screen storytelling layout to create an emotional, immersive reading experience for school-age readers. It is hosted publicly so anyone can access it without login.

It addresses the challenge by giving a voice to discarded equipment - showing that their science, their history, and their presence still matter, even after their missions ended.
